title: Poster loading screen with camera dive
desc: Code-built ReplicatedFirst loading screen: game poster in a frame, timed progress bar with %, rotating tips, scrolling stud background, then a white flash while the camera dives from the sky to the player.

title: Code-built animated loading screen
desc: Fully code-built animated loading screen (gradient background, floating particles, title, progress bar driven by asset preloading) that fades out when done.

title: Preload progress bar with Skip
desc: Clones a prepared Loading ScreenGui, preloads every descendant of game one by one, updates a % label and tweened bar, offers a Skip button, plays a sound when finished.

title: RequestQueueSize loading + join menu
desc: Classic MM2 loading flow: waits on ContentProvider.RequestQueueSize ('N objects left'), shows Skip after 7 s, waits for character and server data, picks PC/Mobile/Xbox main GUI, fades out, then shows a join-a-friend menu.

title: Intro with preload cap, ban check and Skip
desc: Well-commented intro: removes default screen, hides core UI, preloads logo + intro sound with a 2 s cap, logo pop-in tween, loading dots, save confirmation, ban/warning notice, skip support, then restores game GUIs.

title: Retro Bricks/Connectors join screen
desc: Old-Roblox-style join screen: 'Bricks / Connectors' counter from RequestQueueSize, camera orbiting the map's visible extents while loading, timeout + exit override.

title: Minimal spinning-icon loader
desc: Minimal ReplicatedFirst loader: parents a prepared LoadingScreen, spins pizza icons on RenderStepped, waits for game:IsLoaded(); commented-out code shows a RequestQueueSize-driven reveal and an asset-id dump helper.

title: Smallest custom loading screen
desc: Smallest possible custom loading screen: a full-screen TextLabel created in code, default screen removed, destroyed once game.Loaded fires.

title: Clone HUD after game loaded
desc: Waits for game.Loaded then clones every ScreenGui from ReplicatedStorage.StarterGui into PlayerGui, so the main UI only appears after loading.

title: Preload critical assets only
desc: Preloads only the critical assets (first 100 UI items, then ~200 meshes of the most common models) in background tasks instead of preloading everything.

title: Staged client bootstrap with progress
desc: Client entry point that drives a loading screen through stages (game loaded 30%, constants 45%, player data 75%, controllers 100%), asks the device type when ambiguous, and always tells the server LoadingScreenDone so it spawns the character.

title: Loading finished gate controller
desc: Tiny controller exposing LoadingFinished (BindableEvent) and IsLoadingComplete() so other systems can wait for the loading screen; here it just removes the old screen and marks complete.

title: Studio splash + fake progress
desc: Studio splash ('X Presents' then game title) using TweenPosition, followed by a cosmetic 'Loading Assets (n/482)' counter and bar, then the whole frame slides away.

title: Soft shutdown teleport screen
desc: Soft-shutdown client: reads teleport data, shows an arriving/leaving screen, and uses TeleportService:SetTeleportGui so a custom loading screen shows during the teleport between servers.

title: First-join cinematic with Skip
desc: First-time-player arrival cinematic: letterbox bars, titles, fades, a boss leaping through a forest, zone fly-over; square SKIP button; hold() helper that aborts every step once skipped; sets IntroState attribute so the tutorial waits.

title: Avatar intro camera sequence
desc: ReplicatedFirst intro: loading screen + music fade-in, hides game GUIs/core UI, clones a player model wearing your avatar into an intro set, tweens the camera between shots, then restores everything after a timeout.

title: Intro team select (server)
desc: Server side of a menu intro: flags new players as 'in intro', tells the client to use the intro camera, then on team pick enforces team caps, respawns the player and switches the camera back.

title: Fusion loading spinner
desc: Fusion UI component: an inline loading spinner shown while a state IsLoading is true (rotates on RenderStepped only while visible). Good for panels that fetch data.

title: Pattern: ReplicatedFirst loading screen
desc: Code-built ReplicatedFirst screen: batched preload %, tips, Skip after N s, min time, fade-out, LoadingDone signal.

title: Pattern: batched asset preloader
desc: Collect assets by class and preload in batches with budget, retries, timeout and progress callback.

title: Pattern: skippable intro camera sequence
desc: Letterboxed, skippable camera-shot cinematic that restores camera, HUD and core GUI afterwards.

title: Pattern: loading-done gate (client+server)
desc: Client marks loading done; server can hold character spawn until then; isDone/wait/onPlayerReady API.
